notes: A complete original top-down arcade navigation game with three escalating relay runs, twelve echo pickups, currents, hazards, pursuing enemies, sonar combat, burst movement, score/time pressure, synthesized audio, touch controls and guarded local records/settings. Uses vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript and procedural canvas art with no external dependencies or build step. Performance budget: fixed 120 Hz simulation, at most 8 catch-up steps per frame, 260-particle cap and canvas DPR cap of 1.25; sampled render cadence was 58–60 fps. Browser smoke tests ran in local Chromium/Playwright using an in-memory page because the sandbox blocked direct file:// and localhost navigation. JavaScript and metadata syntax checks passed. Native-origin localStorage persistence was not directly verified; its guarded code path was exercised with a test storage shim.
